SPP1_positive: raw count >0 in prior Mac-RNA gate; NOT cell-specific expression
SPP1_high: within-section Q75 of positive Mac-RNA normalized SPP1, ties included
strata: 3x3 full-section Visium coordinate tile x source UMI halves x Macrophage-core halves; bins recomputed within each analysis source set
adjacency: Difference in % source spots with >=1 directly adjacent target; no self-edges; sources with degree=0 excluded
correlation: Partial Spearman on all Mac-RNA sources with >=1 T-RNA neighbor, including SPP1 zeros; neighbor program mean over T-RNA neighbors only
joint_FDR: 176 planned tests; untestable p stays missing and contributes 1 only for BH
